'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Dalton DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dalton]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
